tips.Coeficient de pierderi tehnice în rețeau: Technical loss coefficient of the distribution network (K_p). Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient de siguranță global, calculat: Overall safety coefficient, computed: Ks = (Kss + Ksr) − 1. Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient de siguranță privind acoperir: Safety coefficient for covering the demand at the source (K_ss). Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient de siguranță privind rezerva/: Safety coefficient for the reservoir reserve/operation (K_sr). Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient de variație orară (K_o) pentr: Hourly variation coefficient (K_o) for household consumption. Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient de variație orară mediu (K_o): Mean hourly variation coefficient (K_o) for public consumption. Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient de variație zilnică (K_zi) pe: Daily variation coefficient (K_zi) for household consumption. Source: NP 133.
Daily variation coefficient (K_zi) for public consumption. Source: NP 133.
tips.Coeficient funcție de regimul de presiun: Coefficient depending on the pressure regime of the distribution network. Source: NP 133.
tips.Cota topografică minimă din localitate (: Minimum ground elevation in the locality (mdMN), reference for pressure calculations. Field data.
tips.Debitul minim orar, calculat: Q_min = co: Minimum hourly flow, computed: Q_min = coef × Q_s_zi_max / 24. Source: NP 133.
tips.Debitul specific de apă per locuitor pe: Specific water flow per inhabitant per day (q_s). Source: NP 133 (typically 80–150 l/person·day).
tips.Debitul unui hidrant exterior pentru sti: Flow of one outdoor hydrant for firefighting. Source: P 118/2-2013, art. 6.28.
tips.Durata teoretică de funcționare a hidran: Theoretical operating time of the hydrants during a fire. Source: P 118/2-2013, art. 6.19.
tips.Lungimea totală a rețelei de distribuție: Total length of the distribution network (can be imported from the schema). Project data.
tips.Numărul de hidranți exteriori (informati: Number of outdoor hydrants (informative, for documentation). Source: P 118/2-2013.
tips.Numărul de hidranți interiori (informati: Number of indoor hydrants (informative, for documentation). Source: P 118/2-2013.
tips.Numărul de incendii simultane considerat: Number of simultaneous fires considered in the design. Source: P 118/2-2013, art. 6.23.
tips.Orizontul de timp (ani) pentru prognoza: Time horizon (years) for the future population forecast. Source: NP 133.
tips.Panta hidraulică medie a rețelei de dist: Mean hydraulic gradient of the distribution network. Source: NP 133.
tips.Pierderea de sarcină pe circuitul rezerv: Head loss along the reservoir–connection circuit, computed: i_med × L_total. Source: NP 133.
tips.Populația de perspectivă, calculată auto: Future population, computed automatically: N₀ × (1 + p/100)^t.
tips.Presiunea de serviciu necesară la branșa: Service pressure required at the connection, depending on the maximum height regime of residential buildings. Source: NP 133.
tips.Presiunea minimă la hidranții interiori: Minimum pressure at indoor hydrants (informative, for documentation). Source: P 118/2-2013.
tips.Presiunea minimă necesară la hidranții e: Minimum pressure required at outdoor hydrants (informative). Source: P 118/2-2013, art. 6.30.
tips.Rugozitatea absolută a peretelui conduct: Absolute roughness of the pipe wall (k), used in Darcy-Weisbach. For HDPE: ~0.0001 m.
tips.Timpul de refacere a rezervei intangibil: Time to restore the intangible fire reserve. Source: NP 133.
tips.Valoare subunitară (< 1). Implicit 0.15: Sub-unit value (< 1). Default 0.15 per NP 133. The fraction of the maximum daily flow needed to compensate hourly variations.
tips.Viteza economică folosită pentru predime: Economic velocity used for pre-sizing the diameter D_calc. Source: NP 133 (typically 0.7–1.5 m/s).
tips.Volumul de avarie, calculat: V_av = Q_mi: Emergency volume, computed: V_av = Q_min × (T_av − T_i) − Q_a × T_av. Source: NP 133.
tips.Volumul de compensare orară, calculat: V: Hourly compensation volume, computed: V_comp = c × Q_s_zi_max. Source: NP 133.
tips.Vâscozitatea cinematică a apei, folosită: Kinematic viscosity of water, used for the Reynolds number. At 10°C: 1.31×10⁻⁶ m²/s.
tips.Rata anuală de creștere a populației, fo: Annual population growth rate, used for the {} year forecast. Source: NP 133.

step8.colQiTip: Flow entering the section: Qi = Qf + q_own (q_own = q_lin × L)
step8.colQfTip: Flow leaving the section: Qf = Q_ext + Qie + Σ Qi of child sections
step8.colQieTip: Hydrant flow, if the section feeds a hydrant
step8.colDiStasTip: Standardized inner diameter, chosen from the PEHD PN10 table based on Dp
step8.colDeStasTip: Standardized outer diameter, matching Di STAS in the PEHD PN10 table
step8.colVefTip: Effective velocity, recomputed from the continuity equation for the standardized diameter
step8.colReTip: Reynolds number: Re = Vef × Di STAS / ν
step8.colDOverKTip: Threshold used to determine the flow regime, based on the diameter/roughness ratio
step8.colLambdaTip: Friction coefficient (Darcy-Weisbach), computed based on the flow regime
step8.colRegimTip: Flow regime from Re and 23·D/k: laminar, smooth turbulent, transitional or rough turbulent
step8.colHrTip: Total head loss on the section: hr = h_lin + h_loc (h_lin = ih × L, h_loc = ζ × Vef²/(2×9.81))
step8.colHnecTip: Minimum required pressure at the consumer (Hb from Reservoir)
step8.colHPiezDownTip: Downstream piezometric elevation: upstream piezo elevation − hr
step8.colCotaDownValTip: Ground (topographic) elevation at the downstream end of the section
step8.colPressureDownTip: Available pressure at the downstream end: Hd = Piezo. elev. − Ground elev.
step8.colPressureDownBarTip: Available pressure converted to bar: Hd [mH₂O] / 10.2
